task.title: Graduate Strength Workout prospectively from Sep 23

result.summary: STRENGTH_GRADUATION_VERDICT=YELLOW; Strength ingestion stays live. Build 53 uploaded no workouts automatically, so Native Build 54 (e249a0f3) adds workouts to the automatic coordinator with a 2026-09-23 activation floor; Server cc3c6e44 adds an open-ended, family-scoped Workout policy (Strength only, no backfill, quarantined, auto-confirm off), fixes the open-window candidate bug, and acknowledges same-identity workout content drift instead of a self-poisoning 409. Deployed, policy applied (13/13 invariants), Build 54 uploaded VALID (delivery 7a7035a0-55cd-4fc0-a504-d25479550fab) -- each on separate Founder authorization. Live Sep 23: the Watch strength workout was ingested by ordinary foreground catch-up with no canary/manual sync/screenshot, canonicalized exactly once, quarantined; both walks kept raw by the family scope; Logger session byte-identical; no duplicate session; strategic 0. Two bounded issues: the Logger session carried start_time only (Native did not stamp finishedAt), so the matcher found no plausible candidate (35 < 50) -- with screenshots gone, Logger-vs-HealthKit matching needs Logger end time plus its own rule and a Founder decision on confirmation semantics; and Build 54 stalled all device->Server traffic from 14:56Z until a force-quit at 15:50Z (app open and Log pull-to-refresh did not recover it).

zero_write_audit.summary: Pre/post deploy audits identical for the Sep 22 state, both policies and all strategic sections (only Build 53 Activity auto-sync moved). Policy apply: 13/13 in-transaction invariants (observations, canonical days/workouts, links, claims, Evidence, daily policy unchanged); independent live resolve matches the authorized record exactly. Post-workout: one new canonical strength workout, two raw walks, Logger v1 identical, Sep 22 link intact, one-to-one 0/0/0/0, strategic 0.

decisions_required: Confirmation semantics for Logger-vs-HealthKit strength matches once the Logger carries an end time: keep explicit Founder confirmation (today's rule) or adopt a reviewed deterministic confident-candidate rule (single same-day Logger strength session whose start lies inside the workout window and whose end/commit aligns) -- and whether such a confident candidate may auto-confirm.

Cardio reconciliation semantics (coexist vs one logical event) before any cardio canary; cardio workouts uploaded under the Strength-only scope stay raw forever (a later cardio policy covers only workouts first uploaded after it), so this should not wait long.
Workout strategic eligibility stays OFF; a later slice should gate it on confirmed links only via the graduation runner pattern.
unexpected_findings: Build 54 in-process sync stall: no device->Server traffic of any kind 14:56:36Z-15:50Z despite an app open and a Log pull-to-refresh; a force-quit/relaunch recovered it immediately. Diagnosis: pre-existing unbounded in-flight coalescing in the automatic coordinator (no timeouts on HealthKit awaits; overlapping bootstraps return the stuck task's result); Build 54 lengthened the tail by appending the workouts stream. Fix planned for Build 55 (per-stream timeouts + rerun-after-in-flight).

Logger-only sessions carry start_time only: the Native Logger does not stamp finishedAt on completion even though the Server maps it to end_time/duration_seconds; Sep 22's confident 99 depended on the screenshot merge.
Independent review found the console entry parsed --families but never passed it to the runner (a Strength-only apply would have scoped every family); fixed and pinned before any production use.
A Server 409 on a same-UUID workout re-delivery would have poisoned the automatic workout scope forever (anchor never advances); fixed as an authorized narrow Server change.
backlog: Native Build 55: fix the automatic-sync stall; stamp Logger draft finishedAt on completion.
Server: Logger-vs-HealthKit strength matching rule (start inside window, end/commit aligned) with reviewed confirmation semantics; fallback end_time from the commit instant for live drafts.
Workout revision support (workout.sourceRevision) so drifted statistics can supersede instead of being ignored.
Cardio canary after the reconciliation decision; HealthKitTrainingReconciliationAudit evidencePackagesOnDay mapping returns nulls (audit-only).
recommended_next_step: Founder: decide the confirmation semantics for Logger-vs-HealthKit strength matches and the cardio reconciliation model; no device action is needed -- Strength ingestion stays live and safe (quarantined, unlinked) until the Build 55 + matching slice ships.
